recommendation: Keep the source fix. Future changes to FormatCodes membership or expansion should be handled in THO/IHE/UTG unless a separate FHIR-core issue changes Endpoint's binding or examples.
issue_request: FHIR-28467 was a Published/Persuasive R5 PA request for Endpoint.payloadType to use the full FormatCodes value set already used by DocumentReference instead of manually selected concepts from the IHE OID code system.
initial_application: Git commit 5fc677fa57632c25c76d2acac93f5d333b10dcb3 explicitly applied FHIR-28467 by replacing the copied Endpoint payload-type concept list with an include of http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v3-HL7FormatCodes. Current source still has that include and Endpoint.payload.type binds to endpoint-payload-type.
additional_context: Endpoint is active in source/fhir.ini and endpoint-example-direct is listed in the active Endpoint examples list. Later FHIR-40247 moved payloadType under Endpoint.payload but preserved the Direct example's stale IHE OID system for an HL7 C-CDA code. FHIR-39617 added a newer C-CDA example using v3-HL7DocumentFormatCodes, and THO confirms the Direct example's code belongs to that system.
reconciliation: Changed source/endpoint/endpoint-example-direct.xml so the Direct endpoint example uses http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-HL7DocumentFormatCodes for urn:hl7-org:sdwg:ccda-structuredBody:1.1. The endpoint-payload-type value set was left unchanged because it already imports the THO FormatCodes value set.
source_changes: source/endpoint/endpoint-example-direct.xml: changed the Direct endpoint example coding.system from urn:oid:1.3.6.1.4.1.19376.1.2.3 to http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-HL7DocumentFormatCodes.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published/Persuasive Endpoint issue asking the same payload-type value set to import the FormatCodes value set instead of duplicating copied concepts.
Earlier DocumentReference formatCode handoff established that HL7-authored format codes should not appear as IHE-assigned codes.
Moved Endpoint.payloadType to Endpoint.payload.type while retaining the stale Direct example coding.system.
Added newer Endpoint examples, including an XCA C-CDA example with the correct v3-HL7DocumentFormatCodes system.
